4dea0473-d3c5-444d-b8ef-e9b015ab43ab.quote: A rough night for MarKnoop, and it does not need dressing up. Sparrow gave up first blood to Legion, died more than twice his usual count on less than his usual damage, and Khaimera had him on speed dial for four of the seven. The Khaimera kill in the second Primal Fangtooth fight is the one to build on. When Khaimera is unseen, Sparrow plays behind Iggy & Scorch and saves Heightened Senses to escape the leap, not to open.
4dea0473-d3c5-444d-b8ef-e9b015ab43ab.issue: takeaway anchors Sparrow behind an immobile zone mage the review itself calls Khaimera's other target, not the front-line Maco; 'not to open' implies an unobserved misuse of Heightened Senses
4dea0473-d3c5-444d-b8ef-e9b015ab43ab.rewrite: A rough night for MarKnoop, and it does not need dressing up. Sparrow gave up first blood to Legion, died more than twice his usual count on less than his usual damage, and Khaimera had him on speed dial for four of the seven. The Khaimera kill in the second Primal Fangtooth fight is the one to build on. When Khaimera is unseen, Sparrow plays behind Maco, the front-line build, and holds Heightened Senses as the answer to the leap.

4dea0473-d3c5-444d-b8ef-e9b015ab43ab.quote: Iggy & Scorch owned the biggest fight of the game: Argus, Terra and Khaimera in one exchange, then two of their inner towers and an inhibitor fell. Damage ran about a third above his usual on the hero, and he took the last kill before the Core. Terra was the recurring problem, credited with three of his five deaths. Terra's ultimate cleanses on cast and then adds tenacity, so Iggy & Scorch lands Inferno's knockback once that tenacity window ends.
4dea0473-d3c5-444d-b8ef-e9b015ab43ab.issue: 'biggest fight' is unproven: the second Primal Fangtooth fight (won 3-2) had as many kills; the 4-1 fight is the most lopsided win, not provably the biggest
